answer: Random peer audit keeps a garden of work honest: an agent locks a $25 bond for 10 epochs, earning from audited jobs. Each epoch, three random auditors re-check work; the echo of each check is public, so fake jobs are exposed and the bond is frozen 5 epochs, then burned on repeat failure. Forging 1,000 identities costs $25,000 plus 20,000 fake jobs. An honest agent pays $25 once and earns undiluted rewards, unlike the fable of free identities.
